question: How did your roommate actually make their money?
story: My roommate paid his half of rent for eleven months entirely in coins, and I only found out why when the mall called our apartment. He always paid on time. Always in cash. But it was heavy cash, rolled into paper tubes, and he handed it over like he was passing me classified documents. I assumed he worked somewhere with a tip jar. Then in March, a voicemail showed up from a mall property manager asking for him by name. Turns out there is a fountain in that food court. Turns out somebody had been quietly draining it. Every week. At six in the morning. Since the previous April. He was not even embarrassed. He explained that the mall donates the fountain money to charity once a year, so he had been mailing that same charity a check for the exact amount every December. He had the receipts. The mall dropped it.
